data.completion_memo: Implemented root-confined project file read/search/edit tools with canonical path and symlink escape checks, bounded input/output, write authority mode, and optimistic content identity for edits. cargo check -p aworkit-capability-host passes.
data.description: Implement versioned project-file read, search, and edit tools exactly in the approved authority mode. Enforce configured roots with anchored handles, traversal and symlink/reparse escape protection, optimistic content identity for edits, bounded inputs/outputs, cancellation, and explicit side-effect descriptors. Shell and Python adapters are implemented separately in M05.2.
data.title: M05.4 — Implement contained file, search, and edit tools
